chat.text: Strongest agreement I’m seeing is Frejulfe (Cork 12:49) — 6 of us onside.
Price on that one is about 7.5. Fine as an anchor if we build a double, but I want at least one longer leg.
I’d rather not just rubber-stamp the favourite cluster. Frejulfe at 7.5 is the one I’d pair for a bit of value.
As long as the yard angle isn’t fighting the form, I’m fine with a short-priced leg plus one each-way type.
Race shape matters on the big-field handicaps — don’t load six legs that all need a perfect trip.
I’m happy to go with the group double if we’re honest about confidence and not stacking six thin opinions.

If we’re doing a 6-fold for fun, keep stakes tiny: Frejulfe (Cork 12:49) + Frejulfe (Cork 14:49) + Frejulfe (Exeter 13:37) + Frejulfe (Punchestown 13:30) + Frejulfe (Exeter 12:37) + Frejulfe (Cork 15:49).
Agreed — small stakes on the long accas. Main focus stays the single and double where agreement is highest.
